name: Supabase
summary: Open-source Postgres development platform with auth, APIs, realtime, storage and vectors.
description: Supabase provides each project with a full Postgres database plus authentication, instant data APIs, edge functions, realtime subscriptions, file storage and vector embeddings. The platform is open source and can be self-hosted. The Free plan suits small projects but pauses projects after a week of inactivity; Pro starts at $25 per month, with extra projects from $10 per month. Each project is a full Postgres database rather than a proprietary data store.
